name: sha256chain
description: SHA-256 hash chain h_{i+1} = SHA-256(h_i) (#10): plain C, Zknh, RVV multi-buffer x16, accelerator (SHA-256 engine; SHA-512 and SHA3-256 chains on the streaming engine)
expect: KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 OK: C, Zknh, RVV x16
KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-512 / FIPS 202 SHA3-256 OK: accelerator
units: hashes per region (RVV x16: the hashes are split over 16 independent chains)

sdk.description: SDK default -march (rv64gcv + B, Zbc, Zcb, Zicond, Zbk*, Zkn*): every implementation is in the one image
